workflow.name: Browser interaction and video gates
workflow.jobName: Connected app, Studio, admin and encoded movies

groups.name: Admin workspace
groups.scope: Actual shared admin components with synthetic records/navigation.

groups.name: Public web and social
groups.scope: Actual public-web modules with synthetic Auth/database/media/navigation adapters.

groups.name: Jobs, applications, Market and orders
groups.scope: Actual commerce components with synthetic Auth/database/navigation; no real payment or provider operation.

groups.name: Studio business and creator journeys
groups.scope: Actual Studio components with synthetic records/RPC adapters; no real publishing worker.

groups.name: Story video export
groups.scope: Five real encoded VP9 WebM outputs; decoded trim, color, timed-sticker and audio checks, plus rejection/cancellation modes.

groups.name: Memory movie export
groups.scope: Six real encoded VP9 movies with decoded pixels/audio, including silence, score and once/loop voiceover; interruption and unsupported-content guards.

groups.name: Music library and retained exports
groups.scope: Two real encoded movies, revocation before download, browser capture through a fake microphone, and cancelled-recording cleanup; synthetic private-audio transport.

totals.note: Media modes include deliberate rejection and cancellation cases; these are not counts of live backend or provider journeys.

scope.actual: Chromium executes mounted application components and browser media APIs. Encoded output files are decoded to check pixels, timing and audio.
scope.synthetic: Backend, Auth, Storage, navigation and provider adapters use controlled fixtures. Microphone input and source media are generated fixtures.
notEstablished: Physical microphone, iPhone/Android or Photos acceptance
scope.reviewOnly: This receipt independently inspects the completed hosted run, logs and downloaded artifact. No application tests were rerun and no application source was changed.
